title: Cucco Ranch
description: Objective: Dodge the Cuccos flying in the ranch for 30 seconds. Each level increases the number and size of Cuccos. Level 1 (Egg): _Cost:_ 20 Rupees _Reward:_ 40 Rupees Level 2 (Chick): _Cost:_ 30 Rupees _Reward:_ 60 Rupees Level 3 (Rooster): _Cost:_ 50 Rupees _Reward:_ 150 Rupees and a [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214573) Level 4 (Endless): _Special:_ As the name implies, this level is endless-ish. _Cost:_ 10 Rupees _Reward:_ 100 Rupees per 100 seconds _Special reward:_ Lasting 1,000 seconds rewards 3,000 Rupees

title: Rupee Rush
description: Objective: Collect as many Rupees as you can within 30 seconds. Remaining time is not displayed in game. Ending closer to 30 seconds multiplies the amount, while going over 30 seconds nullifies it. Cost: 50 Rupees Reward: The first time the player collects over 100 Rupees, he receives a [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214649)

title: Hyrule Hotfoot
description: Objective: Race to the other racing bro behind [Rosso's House](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214588) within the time limit. Cost: 20 Rupees. Rewards: - Level 1 (75 seconds): 100 Rupees - Level 2 (65 seconds): [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214714) - Level 3 (beat your previous time): 300 Rupees

title: Treacherous Tower
description: Objective: Defeat all enemies in the room to advance; complete all rooms to win the level. Further levels have harder enemies and more rooms. When replaying a level, beating it with a lower time will yield additional Rupees. Beginner (5 rooms): _Cost:_ 100 Rupees _Reward:_ 300 Rupees Intermediate (15 rooms): _Cost:_ 200 Rupees _Reward:_ 1,000 Rupees and a [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215193) Advanced (50 rooms): _Cost:_ 300 Rupees _Reward:_ 5,000 Rupees _Other rewards:_ Beating the level for the first time upgrades the [Lamp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214555) to the Super Lamp. Beating it a second time upgrades the [Net](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214571) to the Super Net.

title: Fortune's Choice

title: Master Sword
description: Location: Deep in the Lost Woods; solve the maze riddles to access. Requirements: - [Pendant of Courage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214559) - [Pendant of Power](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215121) - [Pendant of Wisdom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215141)

title: Big Bomb Flower
description: Location: In [Bomb-Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215218)'s garden. Access must be purchased for 200 Rupees. Utility: Blows up large cracked boulders. Note: This bomb isn't carried; it must be pushed to destination without taking damage. When consumed, another grows in this spot.

title: Titan's Mitt
description: Location: [Desert Palace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215257) - 1st floor, central room. Use the [Sand Rod](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214602) to build sand bridges across the pillars, and Wall Merge behind the sandfall to a chest. Utility: Move large rocks.

title: Bee Badge
description: Location: Traded by the [Bee Guy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214570) for a Golden Bee (one can be purchased [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215304)). Utility: Befriends bees, making them attack the enemies instead.

title: Hylian Shield
description: Location: [Turtle Rock](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215326) - Floor B1, central room. Kill all 4 Red Mages to spawn a chest on a pillar. Utility: Blocks magical attacks.

title: Blue Mail
description: Location: [Swamp Palace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215331) - Floor B1, central room. Lower the water level to 1 bar, then jump in the central pond and swim to the northern room. Utility: Halves damage taken.

title: Stamina Scroll
description: Location: [Ice Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215336) - Floor B3, central room. On the higher platform on the right; drop down from the floor above. Utility: Increases maximum stamina.

title: Triforce of Courage
description: Location: Automatically granted once saving all 7 Sages: - [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215330) - [Rosso](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215340) - [Irene](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215262) - [Gulley](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215300) - [Seres](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215311) - [Osfala](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215235) - [Oren](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215335) Utility: Progresses the game.

title: Red Mail
description: Location: [Lorule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215342) - Floor 4, central room. Turns off all torched to reveal the hidden path to the south. Utility: Halves incoming damage; stacks with [Blue Mail](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215333) for a total of 75% damage reduction.

title: Golden Bee
description: Location: Sold by the [Mysterious Man](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215303) for 888 Rupees. Can be traded to the [Bee Guy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214570) for the [Bee Badge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215305)

title: Stuck Turtle
description: Location: High up on the wall; Wall Merge from the western cliff to dislodge it.

title: Attacked Turtle
description: Location: In the middle of the water; defeat the nearby enemies to save it.

title: Stranded Turtle
description: Location: On its back, on the shore; use the [Titan's Mitt](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215258) to throw it back into the water.
